creo-ind-perf-act.note: creasti: the shortened spelling the Vulgate uses here. The longer forms in -vi- are equally correct.

ambulo-ind-perf-act.note: ambulasti, ambulastis: the shortened spellings the Vulgate uses here. The longer forms in -vi- are equally correct.

suus.note: suis is the same in all three genders.
